_readme: Links the room-link seeder (npm run db:seed:links) shares into community chats.
Grouped by room theme: music, sports, gaming, food, film, tech, general. 'general' is the fallback for every room.
An entry is a URL string, or { "url": "...", "caption": "text sent with it" } to choose the message text yourself.
Accepted shapes (anything else is skipped with a warning, because the app would not show a player for it):
Facebook:  https://www.facebook.com/reel/<id>   or   /watch/?v=<id>   or   /<page>/videos/<id>   or   https://fb.watch/<code>/
Use public posts only. Instagram and TikTok posts the crawlers already ingested are added automatically from SocialFeedItem.
